html.body: Date: 2025-03-14 REMARKSSummary of Claim Amendments In response to the Office Action, claims 1-8 have been amended, claim 10 has been canceled, and no claims have been added. No new matter has been added. Claims 1-9 are now pending.Allowable Subject Matter Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that claim 10 contains allowable subject matter. In response, Applicant has amended claim 1 to include all the limitations of allowable claim 10, including all any intervening claims. As noted below, Applicant has also amended claim 1 to address the §112 rejections set forth in the Office Action.Claim Interpretation The Office has taken the position that certain claims include means-plus-function elements that must be interpreted under 35 U.S.C. §112(f). While Applicant disagrees, Applicant has amended the claims to replace the "first release component" and the "second release component" with the "first release layer" and the "second release layer," respectively, so as to remove any interpretation of these elements as being means-plus-function elements. Acknowledgement of the same is respectfully requested.Response to Rejections/Objections Claim Rejections - 35 U.S.C. 112 Claims 1-10 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as allegedly being indefinite. In response, Applicant has amended the claims to be in full compliance with all §112 requirements.Reconsideration and withdrawal of this rejection is respectfully requested.Claim Rejections - 35 U.S.C. 102 Claims 1, 3 and 6 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by U.S.Publication No. 2019/0046033 (hereinafter "Gannon"). Claims 2, 4-5 and 7 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Gannon in view of U.S. Patent No. 9,580,626 (hereinafter "Colby"). Claims 8-9 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Gannon in view of Colby and further in view of U.S. Publication No. 2018/0243141 (hereinafter "Park").With the amending of claim 1 to include the subject matter of allowable claim 10, these rejections are deemed moot.Conclusion In view of the foregoing, favorable consideration of the amendments to claims 1-8, and allowance of the present application with claims 1-9 is respectfully and earnestly solicited.If for any reason the Examiner feels the application is not now in condition for allowance, it is respectfully requested that the Examiner contact the undersigned practitioner at the telephone number indicated below to arrange for an interview to expedite the disposition of this case.If this communication is filed after the shortened statutory time period had elapsed and no separate petition is enclosed, Applicant(s) hereby petitions, under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136(a), to extend the time for filing a response to the outstanding Office Action by the number of months necessary to avoid abandonment under 37 C.F.R. § 1.135. Please charge any fee due under 37 C.F.R. §1.17, to our Deposit Account No. 01-2300, under 036433.04638, from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.Customer No: 38485 Respectfully submitted, ArentFox Schiff LLP 1301 Avenue of the Americas, 42nd Floor New York, NY 10019 Telephone: (212) 484-3900 By: /Richard LaCava/ Facsimile: (212) 484-3990 Richard LaCava patentdocket@afslaw.com Registration No.: 41,135
